elections.title: Sri Lankan Presidential Governance Election 2026
elections.description: Institutional preferential election evaluating candidate platforms across Sri Lankan provincial districts with automated 2nd preference tie resolution.

candidates.name: Hon. Anura Dissanayake (Alliance)
candidates.description: Economic modernization, anti-corruption, and digital governance.

candidates.name: Hon. Sajith Premadasa (Democrat)
candidates.description: Social welfare, rural infrastructure, and export growth.

candidates.name: Hon. Ranil Wickremesinghe (Reform)
candidates.description: Financial stabilization, debt restructuring, and trade policy.

elections.title: National Energy & Digital Infrastructure Referendum
elections.description: Public governance ballot on decentralizing provincial clean energy allocation and smart grid infrastructure investments.

candidates.name: Proposal A: Solar Microgrid Network Expansion
candidates.description: Allocate 40% of infrastructure budget to provincial solar grids.

candidates.name: Proposal B: National Offshore Wind Platform
candidates.description: Focus capital on offshore wind power generation.

elections.title: Colombo Chamber of Commerce Executive Board Election
elections.description: Institutional preferential vote for executive board member selection with on-chain audit trail.

elections.title: Central Bank Financial Policy Governance Referendum
elections.description: Advisory referendum on implementing central bank digital currency (CBDC) standards for cross-border settlement.

candidates.name: Option 1: Adopt Wholesale CBDC Interoperability Standard
candidates.description: Integrate institutional ledger for trade settlements.

candidates.name: Option 2: Retain Traditional RTGS Infrastructure
candidates.description: Maintain existing domestic real-time gross settlement.

elections.title: Provincial Rural Connectivity & Digital Education Fund
elections.description: Governance proposal on funding broadband infrastructure for 500 rural schools across Sabaragamuwa and Northern provinces.

candidates.name: Approve 100% Grant Allocation for School Fiber Networks
candidates.description: Direct provincial budget to rural education connectivity.

candidates.name: Approve Public-Private Partnership Telecom Concession
candidates.description: Leverage private sector telecom infrastructure investment.
